provenance: Five original phases recovered verbatim as delivery checkpoints from October 5 RAM Corporation plan; not assertions of completed work or GitHub PR numbers.

items.title: Phase 0 — Product/compliance definition
items.details: Counsel/veterinary-reviewed pilot species, states, independent-cull and broker legal characterization, agreements, workflow, wireframes and data dictionary; no completion without external approvals

items.title: Phase 1 — Foundation
items.details: Organization identity, RBAC, supplier onboarding, animal listings, document store, research requests, manual-match console, audit and design system

items.title: Phase 2 — Transactional MVP
items.details: Matching, quotes, purchase order/checkout, supplier acquisition/broker terms, veterinarian workspace, clearance, notifications, ledger and operational analytics

items.title: Phase 3 — Pilot
items.details: Verified real producer feeds, diagnostic integration, first legitimate corridor transports, incident processes, animal welfare, researcher UAT and financial reconciliation

items.title: Phase 4 — Scale-ready
items.details: Versioned rules interface, multi-state scale, SSO/API, supplier batch interfaces, procurement flows, audited matching v2 and second phenotype/species groundwork
